a0_open.description: Open one function: a handle line, then the function (callee signatures with scope "deps"). Reply to a0_apply with the handle line, then replacement node lines.

params.file: .a0/.a0d file under the server root (default: the launched file)
params.dense: dense view; replies under this handle are dense too
params.lean: dense only: no handle line; a reply without one edits the one open function

a0_program.description: Open a program handle: all function signatures, or those around target. It accepts whole fn ... end blocks that add or replace functions.

params.file: .a0/.a0d file under the server root (default: the launched file)
params.dense: dense view; replies under this handle are dense too

a0_apply.description: Apply an edit (first line: an open handle). Returns the new view, or a JSON diagnostic: code (class), id (A0nnnn, see a0 explain), message, expected/actual, fix, applicability (exact or maybe); a failed edit changes nothing. The reply `fix all` applies every exact fix of the last rejected edit, atomically. Spec lines: `+ex ARGS -> R`, `+pre OP ARGS`, `+post OP ARGS`, `-` removes (program handle: `f:+ex ...`).

params.file: .a0/.a0d file under the server root (default: the launched file)

a0_check.description: Validate the program: one line per function with its revision.

params.file: .a0/.a0d file under the server root (default: the launched file)

a0_run.description: Run a function on JSON arguments (u32 numbers, booleans, arrays for arr/struct) in the fuel-bounded reference interpreter.

params.file: .a0/.a0d file under the server root (default: the launched file)
.a0/.a0d file under the server root (default: the launched file)

a0_save.description: Write the edited program to its file (or path, inside the root). Only after a successful a0_apply.

params.file: .a0/.a0d file under the server root (default: the launched file)
